SittingSettlementTests.CloseAndSettle_HonoursPriceAdjustmentsAndDropsRemovedLines (line 176)	asserts PendingLineCountAtClose == 0, but the surviving soup line was never fulfilled, so 1 is correct. The removed steak is excluded because removal drops it from order_current_line entirely; the soup is still outstanding. The implementation is right; the assertion is wrong.
Per your slice discipline these are small, so they fold into the next slice's output rather than blocking it.

M5 Slice 2 — the menu. Extracts at the repo root; 17 full files at exact paths, plus one deletion.

bash
tar -xzf m5-slice2-menu.tar.gz -C /home/kushal/src/dotnet/myrestaurant
git rm src/MyRestaurant.WebApplication/Menu/MenuAvailabilityWorkflow.cs
cat docs/_append/BUILD_PROGRESS-m5-slice-2.md >> docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.md
Delete exactly one file
src/MyRestaurant.WebApplication/Menu/MenuAvailabilityWorkflow.cs — the class is renamed to MenuWorkflow now that it does four verbs, not one. Leave the old file and you get two types registering for IMenuWorkflow.

New (10)
Path	What
src/MyRestaurant.DataAccess/Menu/MenuAdministration.cs	IMenuAdministration/DapperMenuAdministration — create, rename, reprice; row taken FOR UPDATE, menu_item change and its menu_item_event in one transaction
src/MyRestaurant.DataAccess/Menu/MenuEventLog.cs	IMenuEventLog/DapperMenuEventLog — complete uncapped per-item stream, capped cross-item activity feed
src/MyRestaurant.WebApplication/Menu/MenuWorkflow.cs	replaces MenuAvailabilityWorkflow; one post-commit shell over both write services
…/Administration/AdministrationMenu.razor	/administration/menu
…/Administration/CreateMenuItem.razor	/administration/menu/new
…/Administration/ManageMenuItem.razor	/administration/menu/{MenuItemId:guid}
tests/…DataAccess.Tests/Menu/MenuAdministrationTests.cs	Testcontainers, 15 facts
tests/…DataAccess.Tests/Menu/MenuEventLogTests.cs	Testcontainers, 9 facts
tests/…WebApplication.Tests/Menu/MenuWiringTests.cs	8 facts, no container
docs/_append/BUILD_PROGRESS-m5-slice-2.md	append-then-keep
Edited (6, full files in the archive)
OrdersServiceCollectionExtensions.cs (two new registrations + the renamed workflow type — so Program.cs is untouched), AdministrationHome.razor and AdministrationTables.razor (a Menu link each), KitchenWiringTests.cs (the only file naming the old class), and the two Slice 1 test files carrying the three fixes.

Where to look if the build breaks
ManageMenuItem.razor — it's the tree's first InputNumber<decimal>, with the generic inferred from the bound property. If inference doesn't go my way, add TValue="decimal" there and in CreateMenuItem.razor.

Then the rename: KitchenBoard.razor has @inject IMenuWorkflow MenuWorkflow and @using MyRestaurant.WebApplication.Menu, so the property now shares its simple name with a type. C# resolves the enclosing type's members before imported types, so line 733 is fine — but that's the one place the rename could bite, and the fix is to rename the property, not the class. (For the same reason I named the new injections MenuItems/MenuEvents/MenuChanges rather than Menu, which is a reachable namespace segment.)
